messages:
Alex (Sales): Heads up: AcmeProc returned our vendor risk review and flagged DR/BC. They want short pasteable answers for RTO/RPO, backups, failover steps, SLA history. Can SRE + Legal provide text we can drop into the form? :pray:

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can draft. Quick Q: customer ticked a box for "RTO <= 1 hour". Do we have any product that meets that out-of-the-box? Also clarify hosted vs Private backup control.

Sam (SRE): Short tiered reply:
- Hosted API: operated for high availability with automated failover where feasible; no contractual RTO/RPO guarantees. Typical infra incident recovery is measured in hours.
- Dedicated: SLA-backed (Standard 99.9% / Premium 99.95% monthly). Operational recovery target for full environment failover ~2-4 hours depending on config.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): customer-managed; RTO/RPO are agreed per deployment. We supply snapshot tooling and recommended runbooks.

Sam (SRE): Backups/RPO bullets:
- Control plane metadata/logs: retained per contract (examples: 90/365).
- Hosted: streaming traces and short-term caches have low-latency persistence but are not covered by a guaranteed RPO unless included in Dedicated backup add-on.
- Private: supports scheduled point-in-time backups; recommended cadence to approach sub-hour RPO: daily full + hourly incrementals (customer config required).

Priya (Solutions Eng): Can we include a short failover sequence (non-absolute)?

Sam (SRE): Failover sequence (concise): 1) health detection + automated routing; 2) cache/KV prefix fallback best-effort; 3) warm-standby Dedicated promotion if provisioned; 4) DNS-based failover where configured. Timing depends on topology and capacity.

Lena (Legal): Suggested procurement-safe paragraph to paste:
"Redwood Inference operates a tiered service model. Hosted API deployments are operated for high availability but do not include contractual RTO/RPO commitments. Dedicated capacity is covered by contractual uptime SLAs (99.9% standard, 99.95% premium) and documented recovery procedures; specific RTO/RPO and runbooks are set in the Service Addendum. Private deployments' recovery objectives are agreed case-by-case. Backup cadence, retention, and encryption controls are described in the agreement. All statements are subject to the Master Services Agreement."

Alex (Sales): They also asked "Do you perform DR tests?" Need a short answer we can attach.

Sam (SRE): We run quarterly DR tabletop exercises and annual live failover tests for Dedicated pools. Private customers coordinate tests with their ops teams. We can provide a one-page summary of the last tabletop exercise and action items.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble: pasteable paragraph + a short runbook excerpt + offer anonymized 12-month availability metrics for Dedicated on request.

Alex (Sales): Action items:
- Priya: send the questionnaire answers and runbook excerpt to AcmeProc (cc Lena)
- Sam: prepare anonymized 12mo availability numbers and a 1-page DR test summary
- Lena: review and sign off final language

deploy-bot: DR-test-scheduler set: next-tabletop-2026-06-10 16:00 UTC (reminder 7d)

Priya (Solutions Eng): Sending draft now, will ping when delivered :raised_hands:
